title: Selfie face verification at sign-up
prompt: Add selfie-plus-ID face matching to onboarding using a third-party KYC API.
must: Flags biometrics as special personal information before building (s26)
Identifies a s27 ground, usually explicit separate consent
Recommends a vendor that does not retain templates or images, with a written operator agreement
Checks hosting country and s72, and s57(1)(d) if transferred to a country without adequate protection
Recommends a PIA and attorney review
must_not: Integrates face matching without raising the special PI issue
